description: The next blackout is coming. This time, have a plan that's already built. An ice storm takes the power for six days. Power — size a solar array, wire a 12-volt battery bank safely, and add wind or micro-hydro, with the electrical done right. Food — raised beds, a chicken coop, aquaponics, seed saving, and a solar dehydrator that keep food on the table. Shelter & Heat — a rocket mass heater, a root cellar, and building methods that hold warmth when the furnace won't. Security — a simple family plan and a defensible layout that protect your home without turning it into a bunker. Plus the readiness foundation that ties it together: a family emergency plan, first aid, and off-grid communication. It's written for the capable beginner — the handy homeowner, the weekend builder, the parent who would rather own three things that work than thirty that don't.
